id.description: Axiom-assigned unique ID (UUID) of the event.

sourceEventId.description: ID of the event in the source system; unique within one event source.

source.description: Source system that produced the event.

eventSourceId.description: Slug of the Axiom event source that ingested the event.

ref.description: Full URL identifying the subject of the event.

timestamp.description: When the action happened in the source system (ISO-8601 UTC).

payload.description: Replaced at assembly time with the payload schema of the event type.

sourceData.description: Source-specific data. Not validated; contents vary by source.
